summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine managers' transactions under EU Market Abuse Regulation, specifically share acquisitions by board member Timo Ihamuotila totaling 50,000 shares at an average price of €9.0961. This is a standard insider trading notification, not a special situation. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is purely a regulatory report of a board member's open-market purchase on April 28, 2026.
